name: Don Lee Farms Organic Veggie Bites (Raw Fiber Warning)
whyItWorks: Compacted clusters of diced kale, carrots, corn, peas, and chia seeds. Packed with insoluble cellulose and unground seeds that can cause serious bowel obstruction in Crohn's patients with stricturing disease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture & Roughage Hazard: Strictly avoid during active flares or known intestinal narrowings.
